review_candidates.description: Vítej u nás, kde #NewMe není jen heslo – je to vize! Jsme Notino People, komunita lidí s vášní pro beauty a odhodláním posouvat hranice e-commerce. Čeká tě dynamická role, ve které budeš mít na starosti organizaci jeho pracovního i osobního času, pomůžeš mu udržet přehled v každodenní agendě a postaráš se o to, aby důležité věci proběhly správně a včas. Pokud umíš držet věci pod kontrolou, rychle reagovat na změny a zároveň si umíš poradit s tím, co zrovna přijde, může to být tvoje další #NewChallenge. Co Tě Na Pozici Čeká Budeš řídit kalendář a organizovat čas Co-CEO – plánovat schůzky, hlídat návaznosti, důležité termíny a operativně reagovat na změny. Připravíš podklady pro různá jednání – od prezentací a jednoduchých tabulek až po základní reporting. Postaráš se o e-mailovou komunikaci – některé zprávy vyřídíš samostatně, u těch důležitých zajistíš, aby se dostaly ke správným lidem a byly včas zodpovězeny. Zajistíš služební i osobní cesty včetně potřebné organizace, rezervací a briefingů. Nedílnou součástí role je i osobní agenda – od zajištění oběda, kávy nebo dárků až po objednání k lékaři a organizaci dovolené. Spolu s externí agenturou budeš koordinovat Bártův LinkedIn profil. Postaráš se také o další operativní úkoly a zařizování, které pomohou, aby každodenní agenda fungovala co nejplynuleji. Čeká tě role založená na důvěře, profesionalitě, diskrétnosti a schopnosti mít pod kontrolou velké množství různorodých úkolů. Jsi připraven/a být spolehlivou pravou rukou našeho Co-CEO a přijmout svoji další #NewChallenge? Pošli nám své CV.

review_candidates.description: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About The Job We are seeking an Event Design Coordinator to manage the intake, production, and quality assurance of event-related creative requests coming from a wide range of teams across the business. This is a builder-and-gatekeeper role: you'll work hand-in-hand with designers to turn varied, often fast-turnaround requests into flawless deliverables, including booth graphics, signage, decks, digital assets, swag, and invites, while proactively spotting risks (timeline, brand, print spec, or logistical) before they become problems. We are not looking for someone who simply routes tickets. We're looking for someone who understands both the creative process and the operational realities of live events well enough to catch a misaligned bleed line, a missing dieline, or a vendor deadline that's about to slip, and to fix it before anyone else notices. Responsibilities Request Intake & Triage Serve as the primary point of contact for event-related creative requests coming from varied teams across Tether. Scope each request clearly: deliverable type, format (print vs. digital), quantity, deadline, dimension, venue/vendor constraints, and brand requirements. Flag conflicting timelines, unrealistic turnarounds, or missing information immediately, and propose a workable plan rather than waiting to be asked. Design Collaboration & Project Management Brief designers with complete, unambiguous specs so work is right the first time. Manage multiple concurrent event workstreams across different teams and deadlines without dropping details. Track status across all active requests and proactively surface bottlenecks before they affect the event date. Quality Assurance (Print & Digital) Review every designer deliverable before it goes back to the requesting team, checking brand consistency, copy accuracy, resolution, color mode (CMYK vs. RGB), bleed/trim/safe zones, file formats, and platform specs (e.g., booth panel dimensions, social crop ratios, slide aspect ratios). Catch errors that would be costly or embarrassing to fix on-site or post-launch (typos, wrong sizing, low-res exports, broken links, outdated logos). Maintain a QA checklist/process that scales across event types and gets sharper over time. Event Documentation & Knowledge Management Document and file all assets, briefs, and final deliverables for each event in a shared drive, using a clear, consistent structure. Organize files so the wider team can easily find past work, reuse assets, and cross-reference specs, timelines, or creative direction from previous events. Keep a running record of vendor details, production specs, and lessons learned per event to speed up planning for future ones. Risk & Logistics Ownership Anticipate what can go wrong, such as vendor lead times, print production windows, last-minute scope changes, and shipping delays, and build buffer and contingency plans into every project timeline. Coordinate with vendors and print/production partners as needed to confirm specs and delivery windows. Keep stakeholders across requesting teams and design aligned with clear, proactive status updates rather than reactive fire drills. Cross-Team Partnership Act as a trusted liaison between business requesters and the design team, protecting designers' time from ambiguous briefs while protecting requesters from missed deadlines. Continuously improve the intake and review process based on what goes wrong (or almost goes wrong) on each event. 5+ years of experience in event marketing, event production, creative operations, or project management with a strong events component. Proven experience managing print and digital production processes; you know what a dieline is, what "safe area" means, and why RGB assets can't go straight to print. Strong organizational and multitasking skills: demonstrated ability to manage several concurrent, cross-functional requests with competing deadlines. Sharp attention to detail, comfortable being the last line of defense before a deliverable ships. Experience reviewing and giving actionable feedback on creative work from designers, without needing to be a designer yourself. A proactive, risk-first mindset: you naturally ask "what could go wrong here?" and build a plan around the answer. Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable managing stakeholders across different teams with different priorities. Familiarity with project management tools (Asana, Monday, or similar) and design review tools like Figma Experience setting up shared drive structures or asset libraries for teams. Fluent in English and Spanish / Italian is a plus. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.
